ops.text: `ccx vcs ship` picked its Graphite lane in cc-notes and died on `gt submit` ("Graphite could not verify you have access to yasyf/cc-notes"): the commit was cut onto a gt-style branch (07-25-viz_...) but nothing pushed, and recovery meant hand-rolling checkout main + ff + rebase + push. Two mismatches fed it: this checkout is plain git (no jj repo, despite AGENTS.md describing a colocated jj repo — `jj root` errors), and gt detection fired even though the repo isn't Graphite-synced. Ship's lane detection should probably verify gt auth/sync before committing into the gt flow, or fall back to plain git push on a repo the user owns.
